title: Understanding Model A
text: Model A includes parameters for height in both inches and centimeters, and weight in both pounds and kilograms. Consider how including multiple units for the same measurement might affect the model.

title: Understanding Model B
text: Model B uses height in centimeters and weight in kilograms. Think about how this model might be simpler compared to Model A and what that means for the confidence intervals of its parameters.

hintAnswer: It implies the parameter might not be significant.
title: Confidence Intervals and Zero
text: If a confidence interval for a parameter includes zero, what does that imply about the parameter's significance?
choices: It implies the parameter might not be significant.
It implies the parameter is definitely significant.
It implies the parameter is always zero.
